Specification: This module is a small model-checking wrapper around the extended module Session11afair. It introduces a concrete constant data set of three string values and defines simple predicates over the inherited state variables AVar and BVar, including a type-correctness condition, an invariant relating equality of bits to equality of the whole messages, and temporal liveness properties about agreement and alternation between AVar and BVar. The file does not define its own transition system or specification operator; instead, it adds state and temporal properties intended to be checked against behavior defined in the extended module.
